import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Set the style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        label = 'None'
    else:
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=label)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.violinplot(data=df, y='Sleep Duration', x='BMI Category', 
               order=bmi_present, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     s=50, alpha=0.6)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(Color: Sleep Quality)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 8)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(8)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.35
ax4.barh(x - width/2, occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], width, 
         label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax4.barh(x + width/2, occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep'], width, 
         label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_yticks(x)
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_stats.index, fontsize=8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Value', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation (Top 8)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(fontsize=8)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 5. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps colored by Sleep Disorder
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        label = 'None'
    else:
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        label = disorder
    ax5.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=40, label=label)
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps by Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(fontsize=8)
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Age distribution by Gender and Sleep Disorder
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
gender_disorder = df.groupby(['Gender', sleep_disorder_clean]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
gender_disorder.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, width=0.7, alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=8)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
